newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Vendex 1996/97 profit up 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Vendex 1996/97 profit up 30 pct.

text.p: Dutch retailer and services group Vendex International on Tuesday reported a 30 percent leap in net profits to a record 539 million guilders ($277.1 million) and confirmed plans to spin off a large part of the company.

The profit figure was right in line with analyst expectations although the firm's operating profit, excluding income from the development and sale of property, was just below forecasts at 362 million guilders.
Vendex said it would place some 600 million guilders worth of shares in its business services division, called Vedior, on the Amsterdam bourse by the middle of the year.
The decision to demerge the operation was taken earlier this year after Vendex announced its acquisition of French temprorary employment agency BIS.

Vendex announced a dividend of two guilders, up from 1.50 a year ago and repeated a previous profit forecast for the year ahead, saying it aimed to maintain an annual average profit rise of at least 10 percent. ($ = 1.945 Dutch Guilders)
